rubric.role_summary: New-grad or early-career payment operations role supporting customer and bank inquiries, resolving issues across payment rails, and improving operational processes and systems.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
New-grad or early-career payment operations role supporting customer and bank inquiries, resolving issues across payment rails, and improving operational processes and systems.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree.
- Lightweight technical skills in SQL, JavaScript, or Python.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Lightweight technical skills in SQL, JavaScript, and Python.
- Familiarity with NACHA operating rules, wire transfer standards, and payment processing concepts.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.

source_quotes: This role reports to the Head of Solutions Engineering and is based in our Presidio office in San Francisco (3+ days/week in-person).

soft_requirements: Aptitude to learn quickly and use AI.
Strong written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Organization and ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Customer empathy, bias for action, and motivation to solve customer problems and improve processes.
Willingness to build from scratch with minimal oversight.
